method: Read all 423–543; distinguish professional staff from peer mentors and add receptive action/register vocabulary. Revisit covered contrast clauses and movement expressions. No graphic practice, invented consent, audio correction or timestamp.
phrases: a big and you have a little
a peer mentor and a newer member being mentored in a fraternity or sorority
一位带领新成员的学长或学姐，以及一位受其带领的新成员
In her sorority, a big mentors a little during the first year.
在她的姐妹会里，学姐会在新成员的第一年给予带领。

Big and little are role labels, not body size or literal siblings. Read with 428: a student peer differs from the paid house mom described in 429–450. The source's repeated you have is spoken framing, not part of the role name.
threesome
sexual activity involving three people, in this context
三人性行为（此处的语境义）
The language guide explains the sexual meaning of threesome without graphic detail.
语言指南不作露骨描述，只解释 threesome 在性语境中的意思。
The word can mean a group of three elsewhere; here propositioned and subsequent context establish the sexual sense. A proposal does not imply agreement or capacity to consent.
forces oral
forces oral sex, using an abbreviated sexual expression
强迫口交（原文省略了 sex）
The report uses the shortened phrase 'forces oral' to describe alleged coercion.
报道用省略说法“forces oral”描述被指称的强迫行为。
Oral is elliptical for oral sex here, not an oral exam or spoken discussion. Preserve the abbreviated source; the explanation is receptive and non-graphic, not a reconstructed quotation.
intercourse
sexual intercourse, in this context
性交
The glossary defines intercourse in neutral, non-graphic terms.
词汇表以中性、不露骨的语言解释 intercourse。
Sexual sense follows forcing in the source, explicitly describing alleged coercion. Do not replace it with a benign social-interaction sense or imply consent.
slapping
striking with an open hand
用张开的手拍打；掌掴
The scene shows a character slapping the table in frustration.
这个场景里，一个人物因沮丧而拍打桌面。
Open-hand strike, distinct from grasping or a fist punch. Kept slapping and multiple times both mark repeated action in the attributed source.
buttocks
the two rounded fleshy parts at the back of the hips
臀部
The anatomy diagram labels the buttocks.
解剖示意图标出了臀部。
Neutral anatomical plural; source on the buttocks identifies the affected body area. The teaching example adds no graphic details to the alleged assault.
bruising
marks or discoloration caused by injury beneath the skin
淤青；瘀伤
The character noticed bruising on her arm after the fall.
那个角色摔倒后注意到手臂上出现了淤青。
Resulted in connects the alleged repeated blows to a stated injury. This vocabulary definition is not a diagnosis or independent verification of the alleged cause.
hops onto
moves quickly or with a small jump onto a surface
轻快地跳上；一下子上到……上
The cat hops onto the windowsill every morning.
猫每天早上都会跳上窗台。
Onto marks movement to a surface, unlike on for a position. The source describes moving to a bed while remaining in the room; it does not specify an exact jump height.
decent individual
a person behaving in a reasonably kind or morally acceptable way
正派的人；行为还算像样的人
She described the neighbor as a decent individual who always offered to help.
她说那个邻居是个正派的人，总愿意帮忙。
Perhaps and the following But no frame this as a hope that the narrator immediately rejects, not a reliable assessment of the entrant.
uncovered
discovered or revealed, in this figurative use
被发现；被揭示出来
The review uncovered a mistake in the totals.
复查发现了总数中的一个错误。
Not physically removing a cover here. Source passive going to be uncovered anticipates discovering a decent person; 521 reverses that expectation.
groping
touching someone's body sexually, especially without consent in this context
猥亵性摸碰；此处指未经同意的摸弄
The training explains why groping is unacceptable.
培训说明了为什么猥亵性摸碰不可接受。
This is not the nonsexual searching-by-touch sense of grope for a light switch. Source attribution and repeated unwanted contact are preserved; no erotic or procedural detail is added.
initiating another assault
beginning a further assault
开始又一次侵害行为
The report accuses the character of initiating another assault.
报道指控那个角色开始了又一次侵害行为。
Initiate here means begin, not admit someone to membership. Source all without Jane's consent states lack of consent; the teaching example remains attributed.
free pussy
a vulgar, dehumanizing claim that a woman is available for sex without payment
把女性说成可免费供人发生性行为的对象（极粗俗、物化的说法）
The article condemns the phrase 'free pussy' as dehumanizing.
文章谴责“free pussy”这种说法把女性物化。

Pussy is vulgar genital slang used here to reduce a person to sexual availability. Free does not mean consensual. This is receptive source vocabulary, never an endorsed invitation or everyday speaking model.

Contrast what happened with a fact that would lead one to expect otherwise.
Despite the fact that + subject + verb, main clause; shorter alternative: although + clause.
Source contrasts alleged service of drinks with underage status. Contrast does not by itself establish legal liability; do not replace despite the fact that with despite of.
你准备出门散步，虽然天气有些冷，但仍决定按原计划行动。

segments: phrase:7:a big and you have a little

Peer mentor/new-member labels now have explicit support and a university glossary check. Read 428–450: these student roles differ from the salaried professional house director, not from a biological mother solely by age.

Subaru could be the make of the Uber vehicle, but the PDF does not confirm that relationship or rule out transcription error. Keep both names intact; destination and off-campus movement are clear without silently repairing the vehicle term.

The contrast clause now has daily/social/work practice. They're all drinking is the narrator's account, and she's under age concerns Jane specifically; it does not identify the age of every attendee. There's a whole/there's a bunch is a false start before the group description.
phrase:7:pulls jane off to the side

Sexual sense of threesome is now explicitly receptive vocabulary, not an invitation or implied agreement. Pull off to the side means separate from the group; asks if introduces the proposal, all under source attribution.

Passing the bag and powder description are supported. Plopped up remains unusual and must not be silently replaced by propped up. Jane says they said is nested attribution of the substance name, not chemical verification.

The abbreviated sexual term and intercourse now have precise non-graphic receptive explanations. Forces/forcing express alleged coercion; behind/from behind are spatial. The label so-called distances the narrator from the friendship description, not from lack of consent.

Repeated open-hand strikes, affected body area and stated consequence now each have support. Throughout means during the whole event, kept + -ing marks repetition, and resulted in is a claimed causal link in the filing rather than a fresh diagnosis.

The bed-movement meaning is now supported by the literal form in 514. Leaves this still has an unspecified object; 513 confirms remaining in the room but does not identify exactly what the demonstrative refers to. Retain the unresolved source reference.
Moving onto one bed and beginning to sleep are now both explicit learning targets. One of the three selects a bed, not departure from the room or evidence about anyone else's state.

Perhaps expresses a tentative hope, going to be uncovered means about to be found, and right seeks agreement. Immediately read 521: But no rejects the hope, so the paragraph does not identify a rescuer or establish decent conduct.

Sexual unwanted touching and attempted reaching are distinguished. Gets up means rises and comes up behind means approaches from the rear; again signals repetition, and specifically narrows the target. The source's allegation is preserved without erotic elaboration.

Initiating now has the begin-an-act sense rather than membership initiation; the source explicitly denies consent. Giglio versus Jillio in the preceding account remains an unverified name discrepancy, so do not merge identities or silently alter the quotation.

The quoted message's vulgar objectification and no-payment claim now have explicit receptive support. Claims marks the sender's statement; none of these words establish willingness, capacity or consent.

Clarification question repeats the message wording to ask whether it was all that was sent. Only/just restrict content, not ethical seriousness; the repeated phrase does not become an invitation or factual assertion by the course.

Vulgar phrase is supported; alum could be shorthand for the room as inferred in 540. The unpunctuated quoted message does not independently confirm that expansion or an alumnus referent, so preserve the abbreviation.
PU remains a two-letter source fragment. The narrator later gives pull up as typical but immediately allows another meaning; do not turn the possible expansion into authenticated message text.

I think explicitly marks the narrator's interpretation of alum as a room reference. Teaching the vulgar phrase and room name does not settle the abbreviation; retain the uncertainty rather than claiming complete understanding.

This sentence reports a typical expansion, not certain decoding. Read 543's maybe something else as a limitation; the standalone message fragment 539 remains unresolved even though pull up as come over is already taught.
